body:
I have three kids so I decided to try this at night when they were all sleeping. I ate one 25mg gummy on an empty stomach. About an hour went by and I didnt feel anything other than lethargy so I went to sleep. I had vivid dreams and slept soundly. I awoke about 2 hours later very hungry so I got up to get a snack.
All the lights were off in the house because I didnt want to wake the kids. The first thing that happened is I saw a large toy in the living room and thought it was my eldest daughter with her back towards me crouching. It made me almost leap out of my skin and kind of set the tone to slightly creepy.
I kept hearing my younger kids call daddy. It wasnt an auditory hallucination, but rather when you hear something echoing in your head after you actually hear it. Nobody was calling my name in reality. I decided to check on the baby in the crib next. He was sound asleep and lying still but I got wobbly visuals  as it looks like his legs were moving.
The entire experience was creepy. I will have to try again in the daytime sometime when I am home alone.
